# Functions

Every function called from a file other than its own. A function used only
inside one script is not here -- read it in place.

**220 functions in 76 files.**

*Generated -- do not edit this file. To change an entry, edit the `#'` block above
that function in its own script, then run:*

```r
source("scripts/utils/function_docs.R"); write_functions_md()
```
